title: ChallengeHelper
description: ChallengeHelper is a client side mod for IBR challenge tracks that lets you create custom runs and timetrials of a track for better practice and tracking of your stats.

![ChallengeHelper Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8c034a7f99439a9eb71c012dd11dee00d79d9fd6.png)

# ChallengeHelper Mod

_A mod designed to help with practicing and tracking data for IBR challenge tracks on [Boatlabs](https://boatlabs.net/)_

**Main Command Usage: /ch**

## Features

- Create local track profiles for any kind of track
- Track and Region setup system similar to Boatlabs
- Create custom runs/timetrials based on checkpoints _(Ex: START-C9, C4-C9)_
- Time spent, attempts, personal bests, and run progress are tracked and displayed
- Custom graphs which display Passrate and Progress over time/attempts
- Exporting/Importing track profiles and data
- CSV exporting for graphs

## Important

ChallengeHelper is client side only and is designed to work only on Boatlabs
